doc: `monad_test::explain`, proved in Python and in Node. Each proof is a process that reads one request per line and answers it. `monad_test::holds` is the bool cast of `explain` and has no proofs of its own. Paths are relative to this file.

environments.doc: Node 24 or later, which runs TypeScript by dropping the types.

implementations.notes: Runs the laws on a fixed set of samples, so the cost does not grow with the input.
The same test in Node, over the same samples.
